summary: Frontend-only verification of DASH-001 (Auto-convert banner) and AUTH-003 (Profile Set/Update password OTP flow) on production preview. Login flow works. DASH-001: FAIL — the auto-convert banner is not rendered on the dashboard for this merchant (no [data-testid="auto-convert-banner"] in DOM and no XHR to /api/company/auto-convert/{companyId} is fired). AUTH-003: PARTIAL — OTP request works, OTP dialog opens with 6 digit inputs, OTP is read from Redis and verification succeeds (toast 'Identity verified! Now enter your new password.' shown), password form renders with correct data-testids (new-password-input, confirm-password-input, set-password-submit-btn) and the info banner 'Identity verified via email. Enter your new password below.' is displayed. However, the new-password-input and confirm-password-input DO NOT accept any input via Playwright (page.fill, keyboard.type, or native React value setter with dispatched input/change events) — inputs remain empty (value=''), 'New password is required' / 'Confirm password is required' errors appear, and the submit button stays disabled. Inputs are visible, enabled (disabled=false, readOnly=false), have valid bounding rect, and there is no covering overlay. This blocks E2E confirmation of the success toast for the set-password flow.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-convert banner never renders on dashboard. No element with data-testid='auto-convert-banner' present in DOM and NO GET to /api/company/auto-convert/{companyId} is made. Merchant has active txns (showEmptyState=false — other non-empty widgets render), so parent condition passes; the component itself returns null early. Most likely useCompanyStore().selectedCompanyId / companyList is empty when ConversionBanner mounts, so `company` is null → `if (loading || !company) return null;` never resolves. Meanwhile Redux-based components in the same page use company_id=1 successfully. Suggest making ConversionBanner fall back to companyList[0] AND re-run fetchStatus when companyList populates, or subscribe to the same source of truth used by rest of the dashboard.

new-password-input and confirm-password-input do not receive typed values in the browser automation environment. Tried page.fill, page.locator.press_sequentially, focus+keyboard.type, and native HTMLInputElement value setter with dispatched 'input' and 'change' events — value stays ''. Fields show 'required' errors immediately after blur, indicating handleBlur fires but handleChange never registers a non-empty value. The custom onChange in InputField (index.tsx ~L315) rebuilds a synthetic event spreading target: `onChange({ ...e, target: { ...e.target, value: newValue } })`. Formik/FormManager may read from `event.currentTarget` (which still points to the DOM node whose value the setter didn't update) rather than the spread `target.value`, so the state never advances. Confirm-password field has the same custom InputField wrapper. Please reproduce manually in a real browser to distinguish 'automation-only' vs real-user bug; but the synthetic-event reconstruction pattern is suspicious.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/company/auto-convert/{companyId} is never called from the dashboard (network log verified). Backend endpoint was previously confirmed working — this is a client-side gating bug.

Cannot complete because password inputs won't accept text; therefore success toast text ('Password set successfully!' / 'Password updated successfully!') could not be observed from the UI. Backend endpoint reportedly works per main-agent curl verification.

action_items: DASH-001: Fix ConversionBanner so it resolves the current company reliably (fall back to companyList[0] and re-run fetchStatus when selectedCompanyId/companyList populates, or use the same company source as parent dashboard which is Redux-based). Currently the component silently returns null and no XHR to /api/company/auto-convert is ever issued.

AUTH-003: Fix InputField onChange handler to avoid destructing/replacing the synthetic event's target — instead set the DOM input's .value via setter or pass a proper SyntheticEvent so Formik's handleChange sees a non-empty value. Verify a real user can type in the New Password / Confirm Password fields. Automated tests could not type into these fields via any of fill, keyboard.type, or native setter+dispatch, which strongly suggests the onChange contract with FormManager is broken.
Re-run this iteration once above fixes land.
critical_code_review_comments: ConversionBanner.tsx L180: `if (loading || !company) return null;` combined with early setLoading(false) when company_id missing means the component permanently renders null if the CompanyDataContext hasn't hydrated by first mount. Add a proper subscription/re-fetch when companyList changes.

InputFields/index.tsx L315-330: password onChange reconstructs event via spread; this loses the input DOM ref semantics that Formik/RHF may rely on (event.currentTarget still references the original element with value=''). Prefer mutating input value or using controlled state, and pass event.target.value to Formik's setFieldValue directly.

success_rate.frontend: DASH-001 0% (banner absent); AUTH-003 ~60% (OTP send/verify works, password submit blocked by input bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses two-step form: fill data-testid=login-email-input, click role=button name='Continue' (exact=True, else strict violation with google/github buttons), then fill data-testid=password-input, click signin-submit-btn. On production preview NextJS is dev mode so use wait_until='domcontentloaded' only. For OTP dialog inputs, use selector `.MuiDialog-root:has-text("Verify Your Identity") input` and .fill each of 6 digits; the dialog auto-verifies once 6 digits entered (no need to click Verify button). BEWARE: multiple MuiDialog-root portals exist (7 empty ones + the real one). The 'Add a phone number...' text seen in [class*=toast] queries is not a toast — it's the AddContactInfo inline card body; ignore it. The banner and password-input bugs are reproducible and unrelated to Playwright interception (verified via JS-level native setter dispatch + rect/enabled checks).
rca of the issue: DASH-001: ConversionBanner reads company from useCompanyStore (SWR-backed CompanyDataContext). On first mount `companyList` is likely empty → company=null → fetchStatus early-returns and sets loading=false → render guard `loading || !company` yields null. No re-render is triggered when companyList later populates because the state variable `loading` is already false and no effect watches companyList. Fix: watch companyList in useEffect or subscribe via useCompanyId hook and default to companyList[0] with re-fetch on change. AUTH-003 input issue: InputFields/index.tsx custom password onChange rebuilds a spread synthetic event whose `target.value` is stripped-of-whitespace, but the underlying DOM input never receives the value (React-controlled input relies on state prop `value`); FormManager likely reads from `e.currentTarget` or the DOM element rather than the spread target, so state remains ''. Reproduce: enter OTP → form appears → try typing in New Password → value never persists → submit stays disabled.
